title: The Problem Was Bigger Than Religion

top_liked.author: @somersetcace1
top_liked.text:
Leaving religion looks a lot like walking away from an addiction. It removes the substance, but not the habits that made the substance appealing. I’ve never been a theist, but I’ve been in recovery for 40 years, and the parallels are striking.
